verdict.rationale: The setup docs say the Khoj server can be installed with Docker or pip on consumer hardware, so a documented package or image path exists. However, the evidence never shows a single-command install or a working chat within minutes. A community hands-on report also says the Docker build failed on a pyside6 dependency, which undercuts the 'works in minutes' part. Missing for 10: a documented single command, evidence of reaching a working chat quickly, and independent confirmation of a smooth install (the only hands-on report is a failure).
